card.name: Small words in religious or title phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as 'the' or 's' and word pieces inside titles, epithets and religious phrases, like 'Rahab the harlot' or 'Church of the Savior'. Mostly in web text about church, scripture or named roles.

modes.description: The word 'the' inside a name, epithet or church title.

modes.label: Other small pieces in religious text
modes.description: Possessive 's, word pieces or modifiers within phrases about God, bishops or scripture.
